compos.summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is part of a "Track Challenges" feature. It displays a pop-up dialog titled "Your daily challenges," which appears only once. The dialog explains that three easy challenges have been suggested to start with, and users can press the edit button to change them. Each challenge has a daily target, indicating the number of daily events. Users are instructed to swipe the pointed icon each time an event is completed. The dialog ends with a "Good luck!!!" message and an "OK" button to close the dialog.

In the background, there are three challenges listed:
1. "Drink more water" with a visual representation of glasses.
2. "Fill lunchbox" with a note indicating "Earned 0 HH points, 3 meals left."
3. "Park my car far away" with an associated icon.

The top of the screen has a green header with the title "Track Challenges" and icons for sharing and editing. The time is displayed at the top right
